test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only A sits to the left of D. Only four people sit between A and C. Only B sits between G and F, and G is not an immediate neighbour of C.

How many people sit to the right of G?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) Only A sits to the left of D.

2) Only four people sit between A and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c4031253b2352d8ef3ec2b0bea37ad1ff89c26f572d104c6565ceb9d2cd84f9.png] 

3) Only B sits between G and F, and G is not an immediate neighbour of C.

The remaining position will be occupied by the only person left i.e. E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8c83e60a147dffb65f83d19929da7c816ab94b0720cc6fd3554345995c2979c.png] 

Thus, four people sit to the right of G.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
